---
name: Feature request
about: 建议一个新功能 | Suggest a new feature
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 功能描述 | Feature Description

清晰简洁地描述你想要的功能。

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 问题陈述 | Problem Statement

这个功能解决了什么问题？请描述当前让你困扰的问题。

What problem does this feature solve? Please describe the current issue that's bothering you.

**示例 | Example:**
> 我总是很沮丧当 [...] | I'm always frustrated when [...]

## 💭 建议的解决方案 | Proposed Solution

描述你希望如何解决这个问题。

Describe how you'd like this to be solved.

## 🔄 替代方案 | Alternatives Considered

清晰简洁地描述你考虑过的任何替代解决方案或功能。

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 使用场景 | Use Case

描述这个功能的典型使用场景。

Describe a typical use case for this feature.

## 🎨 示例 | Examples

如果可能，提供示例（截图、代码片段等）。

If possible, provide examples (screenshots, code snippets, etc.).

## 📝 附加信息 | Additional Context

在此处添加有关功能请求的任何其他上下文或截图。

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## 🎭 优先级 | Priority

你认为这个功能的优先级是什么？（可选）

What priority do you think this feature should have? (Optional)

- [ ] 低 | Low - Nice to have
- [ ] 中 | Medium - Would be helpful
- [ ] 高 | High - Important for my workflow
- [ ] 紧急 | Critical - Blocking my work
